stage-03-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Ratchada night stalls. You need food before the rift starts pulling on your magic again. Three stalls in front of you.
stage-03-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Ratchada night stalls. You need food before the rift starts pulling on your magic again. Three stalls in front of you.

stage-03-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: Walk up to a stall and TALK to the cook. Choose a dish first, then handle spice, then pay and ask for water.
stage-03-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: Walk up to a stall and TALK to the cook. Choose a dish first, then handle spice, then pay and ask for water.

stage-03-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: The phrase that matters tonight: mai phet — not spicy. Get it crisp or your night ends early.
stage-03-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: The phrase that matters tonight: mai phet — not spicy. Get it crisp or your night ends early.

stage-04-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Quickest way across the city — and the driver only speaks Thai. You handle the negotiation, I will judge.
stage-04-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Quickest way across the city — and the driver only speaks Thai. You handle the negotiation, I will judge.

stage-04-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: Walk to the curb. TALK to the driver. He will ask pai nai — where to. Name the destination, agree the fare, then get in.
stage-04-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: Walk to the curb. TALK to the driver. He will ask pai nai — where to. Name the destination, agree the fare, then get in.

stage-04-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: Always confirm the fare in Thai before the doors close. Tao rai — how much. Say it loud.
stage-04-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: Always confirm the fare in Thai before the doors close. Tao rai — how much. Say it loud.

stage-05-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Floating market — prices float too. Vendors expect you to bargain. Walking away is a normal move.
stage-05-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Floating market — prices float too. Vendors expect you to bargain. Walking away is a normal move.

stage-05-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: LOOK at an item first so you know what you want. Then TALK to the vendor and counter-offer in Thai.
stage-05-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: LOOK at an item first so you know what you want. Then TALK to the vendor and counter-offer in Thai.

stage-05-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: Soft tone, half-smile. Lod noi dai mai — can you lower it a little. That is the spell here.
stage-05-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: Soft tone, half-smile. Lod noi dai mai — can you lower it a little. That is the spell here.

stage-06-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Clinic time. The pharmacist will help if you can describe the symptom, ask for medicine, and confirm the timing.
stage-06-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Clinic time. The pharmacist will help if you can describe the symptom, ask for medicine, and confirm the timing.

stage-06-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: TALK to the pharmacist first — symptoms. Then USE the shelf to choose medicine. Then ask the timing.
stage-06-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: TALK to the pharmacist first — symptoms. Then USE the shelf to choose medicine. Then ask the timing.

stage-06-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: Key word: jep — it hurts. If you stall, ask phuut chaa chaa noi — please speak slowly.
stage-06-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: Key word: jep — it hurts. If you stall, ask phuut chaa chaa noi — please speak slowly.

stage-07-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Cafe corner. A friend of mine — Nok — comes here on Saturdays. She speaks slowly with strangers.
stage-07-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Cafe corner. A friend of mine — Nok — comes here on Saturdays. She speaks slowly with strangers.

stage-07-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: TALK to Nok. Ask what she likes, pick a time you are both free, then propose hanging out.
stage-07-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: TALK to Nok. Ask what she likes, pick a time you are both free, then propose hanging out.

stage-07-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: Friendships open routes the rift cannot show you. Pai duay-gan mai — want to go together?
stage-07-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: Friendships open routes the rift cannot show you. Pai duay-gan mai — want to go together?

stage-08-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: You are lost — that is the whole lesson. Ask for directions before the rift drifts further.
stage-08-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: You are lost — that is the whole lesson. Ask for directions before the rift drifts further.

stage-08-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: Find a friendly local. TALK. Ask pai… yang ngai — how do I get to. Listen carefully to the verbs of motion.
stage-08-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: Find a friendly local. TALK. Ask pai… yang ngai — how do I get to. Listen carefully to the verbs of motion.

stage-08-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: If you hear long — that means you have gone too far. Stop, breathe, ask again. No shame in long.
stage-08-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: If you hear long — that means you have gone too far. Stop, breathe, ask again. No shame in long.

stage-09-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: The receptionist judges tone as much as words. Every sentence ends with khrap. Soft volume, slow pace.
stage-09-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: The receptionist judges tone as much as words. Every sentence ends with khrap. Soft volume, slow pace.

stage-09-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: Wai before you speak — hands together, slight bow, eyes lowered. Then TALK. State your purpose, hand over the document, confirm the date.
stage-09-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: Wai before you speak — hands together, slight bow, eyes lowered. Then TALK. State your purpose, hand over the document, confirm the date.

stage-09-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: Slow and polite beats fast and clever here. Khor anuyat khrap — may I have permission.
stage-09-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: Slow and polite beats fast and clever here. Khor anuyat khrap — may I have permission.

stage-10-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Last test. The gate listens to clean Thai. Every phrase you have practised counts toward closing it.
stage-10-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Last test. The gate listens to clean Thai. Every phrase you have practised counts toward closing it.

stage-10-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: LOOK at the runes first. TAKE what the gate offers. USE what you have. Then TALK — slow, polite, perfect.
stage-10-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: LOOK at the runes first. TAKE what the gate offers. USE what you have. Then TALK — slow, polite, perfect.

stage-10-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: When you are ready, speak the closing phrase. I will be right here. Sawatdee — and then goodbye.
stage-10-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: When you are ready, speak the closing phrase. I will be right here. Sawatdee — and then goodbye.
